description: Not injected: the live front sends preco and quantidade as text when an admin creates a product, and the API rejects them with 400.
note: Found while building this corpus: the suite's test was right to fail. Cause: ServeRest 3.4.0 (ServeRest/ServeRest#571) made the API reject numbers sent as text, as its contract always declared, and the front still sends text. Fix proposed in ServeRest/front#42.
